title: parcels: Gate 3 (tile decode) has been skipping on every unit — port the go-pmtiles 1.31 bounds parser from roads_tnm into qa_parcels.py so the in-CI tile gate runs again
why: run 38328659747 logs for MN and ND both warn 'could not parse bounds from pmtiles show — tile gate skipped'; roads_tnm fixed the same parser in 9da9ae9; until it is ported, the only tile-level check on parcels is the manual live probe of 2026-10-13
